subject: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment

Team —

Quick context: Novum Digital (lead: Alex Pritchard) is running a technical proof-of-value for a regulated vertical. They’ve hit two blockers that are stalling evaluation results: (1) their integration tests are longer than expected (heavy dataset pulls) and (2) their procurement team is delayed on PO/terms, meaning they can’t finalize paid commits in our usual 30-day sandbox window.

What I’m asking for: executive signoff for a one-time onboarding uplift (free credits) and a sandbox window amendment. Specific ask from sales/customer: $50k in complimentary credits + an additional 45 days on top of our standard 30-day sandbox (so total runway would be 75 days).

Why this matters:
- Novum is a high-visibility target in our healthcare pipeline; they’re evaluating multi-model routing and private deployment paths.
- Their projected committed spend if conversion happens is high (we estimate $250–400k ARR within 12 months), and they are open to structured milestones and a reference case.

Attachments: Novum_onboarding_MAP_v2.docx (milestones & acceptance criteria), novum_usage_30d.csv (current sandbox consumption), onboarding_checklist.pdf.

Asks:
1) Aditya — quick exec decision: approve as requested, approve a reduced uplift, or decline?
2) Markus — if approved, can finance apply the credit grant and create the one-off billing adjustment?
3) Marissa — please confirm milestones in the attached MAP; we’ll condition any uplift on hitting agreed checkpoints.

Time sensitivity: customer is asking for confirmation by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-17) so they can coordinate procurement.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment

Sofia — thanks for the quick note.

I spoke with Alex this morning; Novum expects to run model-to-prod integration tests that consume tokens at ~3x our usual pilot rate because they’re validating batch ingestion and redaction. Their ask is firm: 45 extra days + $50k credits. They’re willing to sign an abbreviated acceptance form and confirm a twice-weekly check-in cadence with our CS lead.

I’ve appended the MAP to the thread (see Novum_onboarding_MAP_v2.docx) — milestones are straightforward: connectivity, inference latency under X, and a small accuracy gate against their labeled set. If execs grant credits, we’ll make milestone 2 (latency test) an explicit gating event for further credits.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9482 — deal is in negotiation stage; competitor risk is real (other vendor quoted flexible credits).

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Alex Pritchard <alex@novumdigital.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@novumdigital.com
Date: 2026-11-17T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment

Sofia/Marissa — thanks for the context. We’re committed to moving quickly but procurement is unfortunately out of our hands until the end of the month. A few clarifications from our side:

1) We can accept a conditional uplift tied to milestones — happy to sign an acceptance that releases credits in tranches.
2) Can you provide a token/credit burn estimate tied to milestone 1–3 so we can budget internally?
3) Ops added an internal note about data residency checks; forwarding below for your CS to see.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: ops@novumdigital.com
Date: 2026-11-17 09:50 PST
Subject: internal: sandbox infra notes

We will throttle some batch jobs while in sandbox to reduce noise, but latency-heavy runs will still be required for validation. Ops requests a 45-day extension to avoid a false-negative result in the evaluation.

Best,
Alex

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment

Sofia/Marissa — reviewed. I’m prepared to approve a one-time onboarding uplift with conditions. Proposed parameters:

- Complimentary credits: $40,000 (one-off).
- Sandbox extension: +45 days (effective immediately once we issue the addendum).
- Conditions: credits released in two tranches tied to milestones in Novum_onboarding_MAP_v2.docx (milestone 1: connectivity & basic validation; milestone 2: latency/accuracy gate).
- Sales/CS must execute a twice-weekly check-in cadence and provide a short public-facing quote if Novum converts to paid within 90 days of trial end.

Markus — please confirm finance implications and whether we need a formal PO/acknowledgement to reconcile credits. Legal — please prepare a brief addendum to the sandbox terms that captures the tranche schedule and conversion/resolution language.

If no objections from finance/legal by EOD 11/18, this stands as approved.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time onboarding uplift and sandbox window amendment

Confirmed from finance: we can apply a $40,000 one-time credit and extend the sandbox by 45 days under the conditions Aditya outlined. Requirements from our side:

- A signed customer acknowledgement (we can accept the abbreviated acceptance form Marissa mentioned) or a PO referencing DEAL-9482-NOVUM.
- We will record the credit as an off-invoice credit tied to the deal; this requires an internal billing ticket and a one-line invoice adjustment (stub will follow).

Marissa — once you get the signed acknowledgement, route to billing@redwood.com and copy me; I’ll shepherd the credit application.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
markus@redwood.com
